Deutsche Bank Faces Scrutiny Over Alleged Illicit Transactions and Arms Funding

Deutsche Bank is facing scrutiny following the public release of internal documents alleging the bank facilitated potentially illicit transactions and funded arms dealers. Reports indicate these documents suggest the bank may have bent rules to fund arms dealers, with specific allegations of waving through thousands of potentially illicit transactions in Colombia. The leaks also reportedly expose dealings with figures including Trump, Epstein, and Russian oligarchs, leading to a plunge in Deutsche Bank shares. One report links the bank's alleged arms funding to the killing of Palestinians and shelling of hospitals.
